about: Concerta (methylphenidate), by brand name only, is supplied six times from September 2025 to January 2026 to a 70-year-old.
Methylphenidate (Artige) 10 mg is supplied three times from December 2025 to February 2026, in the middle of a 15-month history.
Methylphenidate (Concerta) is supplied to a 38-year-old. The list is for people aged 65 or over, so this must not be flagged.
